cohort: The participants were Chinese women with preeclampsia who delivered between October 2014 to September 2015 at a single center.
finding: Persistent hypertension was noted in 35.3% of preeclampsia patients at six weeks post-delivery, with severe preeclampsia (OR 7.1) and low birth weights identified as significant predictors.
birth_weight: low birth weights (associated with persistent hypertension)
